note: P is four dark navy/indigo pages (three of them sleep-themed waitlists) with near-identical ease-out curves and glow-bloom hovers, differing mainly in button treatment (glass pill, plain pill, arrow pill, moon-icon ring) and layout (split, centered column, editorial).
